description: Multi-horizon recursive evaluation executed from fixed origin T0 = 2022 across an identical cohort of 276 stations observed continuously in 2023, 2024, and 2025. Autoregressive predictions are fed back into lag features with actual observation calendar years.

horizon_1.input_features: True historical pre-monsoon lags through origin 2022

horizon_2.input_features: 1-year recursive prediction fed back into lag_1 (2023)
horizon_2.uncertainty_note: Multi-horizon recursive uncertainty calibration is unavailable.

horizon_3.input_features: 1-year & 2-year recursive predictions fed back into lag_1 (2024) and lag_2 (2023)
horizon_3.uncertainty_note: Multi-horizon recursive uncertainty calibration is unavailable.

error_trajectory_summary: On the common cohort (n=276) from origin 2022, MAE is 1.518m at h=1 (2023), increases to 1.855m at h=2 (2024, +22.19%), and is 1.730m at h=3 (2025, +14.0% vs h=1).
